name: Rule grant fully overridden by same-policy Deny -> NO positive capability edge, only the denies edge
note: Allow ec2:TerminateInstances on a concrete instance, with an unconditional same-policy Deny of the same action on the same resource. The grant is FULLY suppressed by AWS explicit-Deny precedence. IAM-702 (acceptance suite test 8, cross-test invariant 5 'denies are not grants'): a fully-denied action must NOT emit a positive capability edge (no can-destroy, no can-write) and must not count in risk totals - a suppressed grant is not a grant. Only the `denies` edge remains, carrying the block as the decisive fact. The AUTHORITATIVE FINDINGS TABLE likewise drops the finding (IAM-302; consistent with the frozen negative corpus explicit-deny-suppresses-exfil). Previously graph.js drew a blocked-by-deny can-destroy edge here; that leaked a suppressed grant into the graph as a positive capability edge (a truthfulness harm, threat-model T8), which IAM-702 removes.
